real_inputs: 2026 observed baggage rates and prior predictions; monthly cases are US carrier-months, NOT Cathay claims
ml_choice: LightGBM under:over 1:2 selected by 2025 weighted MAE, not by scenario profit
fixed_risk: per-carrier pooled observed rate in 2019-2025; frozen across 2026
interpretation: one policy / one bag / one covered trip proxy; not real customer count
fixed_costs: excluded; report contribution before fixed overhead/capital/tax. Difference is available budget for incremental implementation cost.
claim_selection: buyers assumed same risk as eligible group; no adverse selection
payouts: one hypothetical fixed benefit for qualifying mishandling, not actual insurance claims
